headline: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited submitted a substantial acquisition disclosure to NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), indicating a significant change in shareholding. The specific acquirer, acquisition value and shareholding threshold details are contained in the filed disclosure document.
detail: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited, a listed entity on NSE, has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the exchange. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure when a person acquires or agrees to acquire 25% or more of voting shares or votes in a listed company. The filing indicates a material change in shareholding requiring public disclosure and potential open offer compliance depending on the acquisition structure and acquirer category.
